name: IPGeolocation.io
description: IP Geolocation provides accurate location data based on IP addresses, enabling users to identify the geographical location of their website visitors and enhance their online services.

events.d: Find a place's local timezone from an IP address, coordinates, airport code (IATA/ICAO/LO), or location name. Returns timezone name, UTC offset and DST details for displaying local times or scheduling.
Convert a date and time from one place or timezone to another using city, coordinates, or airport codes for scheduling or showing local time.
Get a visitor’s city, region, country, time zone and coordinates from an IP address. Optionally include currency, ISP or specific fields.

Retrieve daily sun and moon times (sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset) and related astronomy data for a location or IP between two dates. Requires start and end dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Max range: 90 days. Optional: time…
Find location and astronomy info (country, city, time zone, coordinates, sunrise/sunset, moon phase) for an IP address or location.
Get browser, operating system, device type, and other client details from a User-Agent string.

Get security and risk details for an IP address ,  e.g., whether it’s from a VPN, proxy, TOR node, or known malicious source. Use this to spot, investigate, or block suspicious visitors and protect your site.
Get device, browser, and OS details for up to 50,000 User-Agent strings at once.
Get security and threat details for up to 50,000 IPs from a comma-separated list. Optionally select which fields to return.
Get country, city, coordinates, timezone and ISP for up to 50,000 IP addresses at once.
Get the network owner (ASN), country, and basic location for an IP address or ASN to help with analytics, fraud checks, or routing.
Get abuse and reputation information for an IP address, spam, attacks, or abuse reports, so you can investigate or block risky visitors.
